full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of the civil petition are that the petitioners herein as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.375 of 1975 in the Court of learned Munsif, 2nd Court, Moulvibazar, for declaration of title in respect of the suit schedule land, con-tending interalia, the Government settled the said land to South Sylhet Supply Society Limited through patta; Subsequently the suit land was sold in auction for arrear rent in a rent execution case which was purchased by Khirod Bihari Dev Chowdhury on 19.07.1951 and the sale certificate was obtained on 24.11.1951; Said Khirod Bihari Dev Chowdhury sold the land to the plaintiffs vide two registered deeds dated 15.04.1969; After purchase, plaintiffs filled up the suit land and constructed a petrol pump thereon after taking necessary permission from the authority concerned; The suit land has been wrongly recorded in the name of the Government; Hence, the suit.
